note: Measurements behind the charts in the README. `npm run charts -- --measure` re-runs the token benchmark and rewrites `tokens`; the rest is edited by hand when it is measured again. All on Windows 11.

rows.question: Get oriented in the project
rows.without: list the files (first 400) and read the README

rows.question: Read one function or class
rows.without: read the file it is in

rows.question: Find who uses a symbol
rows.without: search the project for its name (matching lines only, first 250)

rows.question: Gather the code around a symbol
rows.without: read the file it is in, and search for its name elsewhere with 10 lines around each match

rows.question: Check what a change would affect
rows.without: search for its name with 10 lines around each match, to see what the uses are

indexing.note: First index of a project, read-only. The eight outside projects were shallow-cloned and measured on 2026-11-12 (KNOWN_ISSUES.md, N5); Vertskim and three.js are medians of three runs on 2026-11-13.

accuracy.note: Relationships found from syntax alone, checked against a scip-typescript 0.6.2 index of this repository (`vertskim bench --scip`), measured on 2026-11-12.
